#![Bandera UK](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0U5IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2a28e3c285bf55a2606838971abb0514d0ef172c/UK.png) **English**
#All the surplus from this competition will be donated to [Parent and Child Society Gibraltar](https://www.facebook.com/parentandchildsociety/).

If you are a Member of the **Spanish Speedcubing Association (AES)**, the registration fee will be €12.75. If you are not, the fee will be €15.

You can join the AES by clicking [here](https://speedcubingspain.org/register/).


#![Bandera ESP](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0E5IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c7812c9b5d2929fb4ed7644517bf4f9800a3d1e4/esp.png) **Español**
#Todo el sobrante de esta competición será donado a [Parent and Child Society Gibraltar](https://www.facebook.com/parentandchildsociety/).

Si eres Miembro de la **Asociación Española de Speedcubing (AES)**, la cuota de registro será de 12,75€. Si no lo eres, la cuota será de 15€.

Puedes unirte a la AES pinchando [aquí](https://speedcubingspain.org/register/).
